mapper.sql: id, skill_id, snapshot_json, snapshot_hash, status, submitter_user_id, submitted_at, final_comment, final_reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
id, request_id, target_type, target_id, target_name, status, review_comment, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
id, request_id, dimension_id, action, actor_user_id, previous_status, new_status, comment, snapshot_hash, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_review_request (skill_id, snapshot_json, snapshot_hash, status, submitter_user_id, submitted_at, final_comment, final_reviewed_at) VALUES (#{skillId}, #{snapshotJson}, #{snapshotHash}, #{status}, #{submitterUserId}, #{submittedAt}, #{finalComment}, #{finalReviewedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_review_request WHERE skill_id = #{skillId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','DIMENSION_REVIEW','FINAL_REVIEW') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM skill_review_request WHERE submitter_user_id = #{submitterUserId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'DIMENSION_REVIEW', 'FINAL_REVIEW') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM skill_review_request WHERE status = 'FINAL_REVIEW' ORDER BY submitted_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_review_dimension (request_id, target_type, target_id, target_name, status, review_comment, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{status}, #{reviewComment}, #{reviewedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_review_dimension WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_review_audit (request_id, dimension_id, action, actor_user_id, previous_status, new_status, comment, snapshot_hash) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{dimensionId}, #{action}, #{actorUserId}, #{previousStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{comment}, #{snapshotHash})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT actor_user_id FROM skill_review_audit WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND action IN ('DIMENSION_APPROVE', 'DIMENSION_REJECT') ORDER BY actor_user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_review_request SET status = #{status}, submitted_at = CASE WHEN #{expectedStatus} = 'DRAFT' AND #{status} = 'DIMENSION_REVIEW' THEN NOW() ELSE submitted_at END, final_comment = #{finalComment}, final_reviewed_at = #{finalReviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE skill_review_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
